_fields.entry_hash: optional SHA-256 hex of this entry without entry_hash field

_format: one JSON object per line, append-only; do not wrap entries in a JSON array. The entries below are illustrative examples — replace them with your own runs.
_chain: Optional integrity chain: when entry_hash/prev_hash are present, validate with scripts/validate-ratings-chain.py. Live-for-fork-work relocations must re-anchor (new genesis line) rather than pointing prev_hash at a missing parent.
